model_meta.description: Inferred conceptual model of the claimed centrifugal pump, its fluid interfaces, rotating impeller, housing, sealing behavior, and drive.

subsystems.description: Motor mounted on the pump housing and driving at least one impeller half; some described configurations drive both.
Facing impeller halves arranged within the volute, held together by plural pins, with plural blades floating on the pins and at least one rotating inlet tube.

ports.name: Rotating inlet tube fluid entry (one or both halves)

subsystems.description: Central housing component contains the impeller and comprises the outlet; two outer housing components are adjacent to the respective impeller halves. At least one outer component includes an inlet.

parts.description: Optional pipe flange attached to the housing (Claim 4).

subsystems.description: Seal slides over the rotating inlet tube and sits perpendicular to it between an impeller ridge and adjacent housing.
External source of fluid or material delivered to one or more pump inlet tubes.

interfaces.interface_type: fluid supply to rotating inlet tube(s)

subsystems.description: External receiving system for fluid or material leaving through the housing outlet.
Optional bearings in the outer housing components support rotation of the impeller halves.
Optional housing passage/weep hole through which leakage indicates a seal needs replacement.

item_flows.name: Incoming fluid/material
item_flows.notes: Fluid/material enters at the housing inlet arrangement and reaches the impeller intake through the rotating hollow inlet tube(s); at least one tube is claimed, both halves may have tubes, and a single-inlet embodiment is also claimed (Claims 1–2 and 6). The external supply boundary is connected to the impeller fluid-entry port without asserting an unsupported internal housing-to-tube connection.

item_flows.name: Pumped fluid/material
item_flows.notes: Fluid/material exits through the housing component comprising the outlet (Claims 1 and 3).

item_flows.name: Rotary drive
item_flows.notes: Motor drives at least one impeller half (Claim 1); another claimed configuration drives both (Claim 8).

item_flows.name: Impeller discharge to volute
item_flows.notes: Fluid forced outward by the impeller passes through the volute/housing toward the housing outlet.

requirements.statement: Move fluid or material from an inlet to an outlet using a motor-driven two-half centrifugal impeller in a volute.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; claim 8 independently recites pumping fluid/material from inlet to outlet.

requirements.statement: Centrifugal loading of the fluid/impeller forces the halves apart against adjacent housing surfaces.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; claim 8 also describes the halves forced apart against adjacent housing.

steps.description: Motor drives at least one impeller half in the claimed configuration.
The rotating impeller forces inlet fluid or material outward within the volute.
The impeller transfers the outwardly forced fluid or material into the housing volute.
The housing/volute routes the discharged fluid or material through its outlet.
A leak through the housing weep hole indicates that a seal needs replacement.
